title: PRESIDENT OF INDIA PAYS FLORAL TRIBUTES TO DR SARVEPALLI RADHAKRISHNAN ON HIS BIRTH ANNIVERSARY
body_text:
The President of India, Smt Droupadi Murmu paid floral tributes to Dr Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan, former President of India, on his birth anniversary at Rashtrapati Bhavan today (September 5, 2026).
